Triage: `domain:engine` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`) · p2 · Bug · `area:api` — **limb ① only; ②+③ split to `domain:cli`**; rationale: three producers still write bracketed openers restating their own declared code, and the pin covers neither

`Path: 可对外的 API | api-backend.error-envelope-ledger(P1) | P② | p2`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T19:33Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here, not in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body risks the platform's citation rewrite.

**The strongest (b) of this family: these are shipped runtime bytes, ⛔ not prose.** Three producers still emit `[tag]` openers that restate the `code` the same throw declares, and `withoutDeclaredCodePrefix` strips only the `CODE:` form, so the bracketed lowercase opener reaches `error.message` on the wire.

⭐ **And the pin does not cover them**: `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts` declares `PRODUCERS = ['protocol.ts', 'sys-metadata-repository.ts']` — two files. The retirement (#16245 / PR #19683, `7a25a3ee9c`) fenced its own scope and these three sat outside it.

### ⚠️ This card is SPLIT, because it has no single lane

| limb | file | lane |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ① | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts` | **`domain:engine` — this card** |
| ② | `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` | `domain:cli` |
| ③ | `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` | `domain:cli` |

**This card is limb ① only.** It is the same package as the precedent, reaches `dist`, has a merged PR as a worked template, and is the one limb that can ride the existing pin by widening `PRODUCERS`. ⚠️ Limbs ②+③ are a separate `domain:cli` card the next sweep files; a round that silently does all three is widening a graded scope.

⭐ **Downstream fact the taker owes**: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:477` and `:514` quote limb ①'s current `[invalid_metadata]` text and are **TRUE until this lands**. Updating them is part of THIS round's acceptance, ⛔ not a separate card.

**Why `Clause-②: no`, and why the filer's `yes` is not adopted:** the body argues `yes` because 「this changes published output bytes」. That is not the clause-② test. The test is whether the card widens an accept set or the public surface. Here every accept/reject verdict is byte-identical before and after; only the message text changes. By `references/lanes/spec.md` that is the auxiliary face, not a contract face. No consumer parses the tag (the body's own reachability reading), so the text is not a parsed contract either. The contract review this PR still owes is owed **by face** (its `.changeset` prose) and is run at delivery by an isolated at-tier reviewer, per `references/contract-review.md`.

2. **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:1140` quotes a bracketed opener its producer does not emit.** The clause reads 「…refused server-side with the ledgered 422 [writable_package_required] naming the writable-package remedy…」. The repository's write-lock refusal (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts:1698-1710`) is plain prose with `code = 'WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED'` / `status = 422` — no opener. This is a different line from the `:477` / `:514` this card's claim already carries in that file, so the claim's file surface covers it; whether this round takes it is this card's seat's call. If it does, the durable form is the one #19705 used: key the clause on `422` + `code: WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, never on message bytes.
